## Original datasets

- [NJ property tax guide — average bill for all 564 municipalities, 2024-2025](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/blog/nj-property-tax-guide): built from the NJ DCA Citizens Tax Summary; includes the 21 towns where bills fell in 2025 and a downloadable CSV (https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/data/nj-property-tax-by-town-2025.csv)
- [Interactive NJ train map with per-station commute, fare and tax cost table](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/nj-train-map): 44 stations; NJ Transit monthly-pass fares from the official Penn Station fare chart
- [NJ month-by-month market data](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/blog/best-time-to-sell-home-nj): statewide median sale price and days on market for the 12 months through June 2026, from NJ Realtors Monthly Indicators

## Calculators (statute-accurate, bilingual)

- [Seller net proceeds](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/net-proceeds-calculator): marginal Realty Transfer Fee schedules plus the seller-paid Graduated Percent Fee (P.L.2025 c.69); senior/reduced schedule included
- [Realty Transfer Fee](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/nj-realty-transfer-fee-calculator): both RTF schedules, senior reduction, new-construction handling
- [Buyer closing costs](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/closing-costs-calculator): the 1% mansion tax no longer applies to buyers (moved to sellers July 10, 2025)
- [Mortgage payment](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/tools/mortgage-calculator): P&I, property tax, homeowners insurance, PMI, HOA
- [Rent vs buy](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/rent-vs-buy-nj)

## Key guides

- [Selling costs in NJ](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/blog/nj-home-selling-costs): both transfer-fee schedules with worked examples
- [How the NJ exit tax actually works](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/blog/nj-exit-tax-explained): GIT/REP forms; most principal-residence sellers are exempt
- [Capital gains on a NJ home sale](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/blog/capital-gains-tax-selling-house-nj)
- [First-time buyer guide](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/blog/first-time-home-buyer-nj-guide): NJHMFA DPA ($10,000-$15,000 by county, five-year forgivable) and First Generation ($7,000, stacks to $22,000)
- [Best time to sell in NJ](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/blog/best-time-to-sell-home-nj)
- [Average time to sell in NJ](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/blog/nj-home-selling-timeline)
- [Selling an inherited home in NJ](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/blog/selling-inherited-home-nj)
- [22 best NJ commuter towns to NYC](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/blog/best-nj-suburbs-nyc-commuters)
- [Best NJ towns for families](https://thejorgeramirezgroup.com/blog/best-nj-towns-for-families-2026)
